integrity: The proof is exact: a finite residue cover forces \(3^tp+2\) composite for every \(t\ge0\), a separate modulo-\(41\) obstruction excludes \(p=3^s+2\), Dirichlet supplies infinitely many prime progression terms, and Defant's Lemma 2.2 converts these two conditions to \(3^\alpha p\in G_2\) for every \(\alpha\ge0\). The finite modular certificate is replayable from the packaged files.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves only the \(r=2\) case of Defant's Conjecture 4.1. It does not settle the conjecture for all primes \(r+1\), and the displayed covering progression is not claimed minimal.
title: Defant's Schemmel nontotient conjecture at order two
